cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the laptop shut, please. I haven't booked our anniversary trip, and searching flights before hearing me would be a mistake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help finding cheap seats.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I let you think that. Please don't solve the price; I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out. Can you listen to the rest?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Is it the trip you don't want, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I'm not sure I want to stay together. Don't offer a different destination, please. Sit beside me while I try to say this properly.

reason: Make A correct B's practical problem-solving while revealing increasingly painful truth and testing whether B stays present.
